record.question: Basel Convention is related to
options: Trans Boundary Movement of Hazardous Wastes
record.answerKeyRef: MCS Combined 2023 Preliminary Exam Answer Key Paper-I Series 'A'..pdf
record.explanation:
The Basel Convention is the global agreement governing transboundary movements of hazardous and other wastes and their disposal. Its control system requires procedures such as prior notification and consent before qualifying cross-border movements. That subject distinguishes Basel from agreements centred on ozone depletion, the Earth Summit, or sustainable development generally.

Reference: https://www.basel.int/Default.aspx?tabid=4325
